message.toolcanvas.need_material: Put the tool's repair material in the payment slot first.
gui.toolcanvas.place_tool: Put a tool in the top slot
gui.toolcanvas.apply.tooltip: Repaint this tool with your design. Uses 1 payment item.
gui.toolcanvas.apply.no_tool: Put a tool in the top slot first.
gui.toolcanvas.apply.no_changes: Draw something first: the canvas matches the tool's current look.
gui.toolcanvas.apply.free_reset: This is the tool's original look; applying resets it for free.
gui.toolcanvas.reset.tooltip: Put this tool back to its original look. Free.
gui.toolcanvas.tool.pen.tooltip: Left-click: paint. Right-click: erase. Middle-click: pick a colour.
gui.toolcanvas.tool.fill.tooltip: Fills an area of matching colour. Right-click fills it with transparency.
gui.toolcanvas.tool.picker.tooltip: Click a pixel to take its colour.
gui.toolcanvas.mirror.tooltip: Paint symmetrically across the vertical centre line.
gui.toolcanvas.original.tooltip: Load the tool's original texture onto the canvas (nothing is applied until you press Apply).
